scope: Original Phanes buttons and glyphs aligned with emergence, light and world creation, with coherent world/music styling, legible action/state feedback and usable desktop/phone controls.

intuitiveness.evidence: Both initial blockers are corrected in independent use. Default music nodes do not overlap at eleven tested widths from 360 to 1440 pixels, including both sides of the changed breakpoints. Every slider hits its own center when scrolled into the usable viewport. Direct input on the formerly intercepted Velvet Circuit slider changes its weight to 51 and leaves Lunar Steps disconnected; tapping the last phone slider also changes the intended style. Labels, distinct play/pause glyphs, camera aria-pressed state, Explore/Create glyph changes, visible keyboard focus, ordinary touch scrolling, arrangement/reset and focus return remain usable.

accuracy.evidence: The registered custom-interface scope is implemented with the generated 24-glyph asset, custom small transport/navigation forms and shared button/control states. The actual RGB/screen compositing boundary is now documented accurately and works in the reviewed dark interface. All ten declared inputs were reviewed in report01; this review reinspected the changed identity CSS and art documentation, retained the unchanged input hashes, and exercised the integrated root and project-path builds. Desktop/phone behavior, current fingerprints and empty page/resource error collections support the result. The accepted controls do not claim that unfinished world-generation or musical-development requirements are satisfied.

wowFactor.evidence: Independently inspected corrected desktop and phone welcome, world/camera and idle/playing music captures. The black tiles and rectangular halos from report01 are gone. Ivory/sage glyphs, opening edges and quiet mineral control surfaces read as one finished Phanes family across world and music, with clear labeled action silhouettes at their actual sizes. The spacing gives node controls room without losing the spatial instrument's character. The result is strong and coherent within this interface-art scope; this grade does not rate the underlying world models, terrain or long-form soundtrack.

thinkingOutOfTheBox.evidence: The original emergence/core idea connects the brand, creation actions, music islands, central pulse and reticle through a practical common visual language. Familiar action shapes remain recognizable, and simple custom play/pause and direction marks serve small controls without unnecessary ornament. The implementation turns the name/mission reference into a usable world-creation and musical interface rather than a separate mythology skin. Initial criticism produced concrete compositing and layout corrections while preserving that concept.
